reviewNotes: The Spirit’s Eve title, runtime setup, spouse conversations, and opening town conversations were reviewed directly against English. Two full editorial audits cover character voice, canonical festival and haunted-maze terms, natural Romanian, and exact controls; both found no remaining objective issue.

Abigail_spouse.source: You'll have to tell me what's beyond, I can't go on... spiders...$s
Abigail_spouse.translation: Va trebui să-mi spui ce se află dincolo. Eu nu mai pot continua... păianjeni...$s

Leah_spouse.source: I may have had a little too much pumpkin ale...
Leah_spouse.translation: Cred că am băut puțin prea multă bere de dovleac...

Maru_spouse.source: I'm confused... you go on ahead and let me figure this out.
Maru_spouse.translation: Sunt derutată... mergi înainte și lasă-mă să mă lămuresc.

Penny_spouse.source: Oh... These vapors... Hmmm... You look nice tonight.$l
Penny_spouse.translation: Oh... Vaporii aceștia... Hmmm... Arăți bine în seara asta.$l

Haley_spouse.source: I get scared easily... I think I'm just going to stay right here.$s
Haley_spouse.translation: Mă sperii ușor... Cred că voi rămâne chiar aici.$s

Sebastian_spouse.source: It would be interesting to have one of these on the farm.
Sebastian_spouse.translation: Ar fi interesant să avem unul dintre acestea la fermă.

Sam_spouse.source: Hey, I was wondering when you'd show up!$h
Sam_spouse.translation: Hei, mă întrebam când o să apari!$h

Harvey_spouse.source: Hi... I was hoping you'd find me here...$l
Harvey_spouse.translation: Salut... Speram să mă găsești aici...$l

Elliott_spouse.source: Mmph... I believe I've eaten a few too many slices of pumpkin pie.
Elliott_spouse.translation: Mmf... Cred că am mâncat cu câteva felii de plăcintă cu dovleac în plus.

Robin.source: Well, winter's almost here. It's a great time to stockpile wood and stone.
Robin.translation: Ei bine, iarna este aproape aici. Este o perioadă excelentă să-ți faci rezerve de lemn și piatră.

Demetrius.source: I haven't seen Maru in hours... I hope she's alright.
Demetrius.translation: N-am mai văzut-o pe Maru de ore întregi... Sper că este bine.

Maru.source: I think I've already been this way... no, wait...$s#$e#I'm lost...$s
Maru.translation: Cred că am mai trecut pe aici... nu, stai...$s#$e#M-am rătăcit...$s

Sebastian.source: I have no idea how these skeletons are walking... creepy.#$e#It's pretty cool though.
Sebastian.translation: N-am idee cum de se mișcă scheletele acestea... Ce sinistru.#$e#Totuși, este destul de grozav.

Pierre.preservationReason: The two question marks are the complete player-visible source and intentionally convey unavailable dialogue.

Caroline.source: I get scared very easily. I'll leave the haunted maze to the younger people.
Caroline.translation: Mă sperii foarte ușor. Las labirintul bântuit pe seama celor mai tineri.

Alex.source: There's something weird over there. But how do I get to it?#$e#There's gotta be a secret passage somewhere around here.
Alex.translation: Este ceva ciudat acolo. Dar cum ajung acolo?#$e#Trebuie să existe un pasaj secret pe undeva prin zonă.

George.source: Hmm... smoked turkey haunch? I guess this festival isn't all bad.$h
George.translation: Hmm... o pulpă de curcan afumată? Cred că festivalul acesta nu e chiar atât de rău.$h

Evelyn.source: I wish Gus would include a vegetarian option. Some zucchini skewers, maybe?
Evelyn.translation: Mi-aș dori ca Gus să ofere și o opțiune vegetariană. Poate niște frigărui de dovlecel?

Lewis.source: Good evening, @. Have you ventured into the haunted maze yet? It's quite spooky.#$e#That strange man who lives in the tower set it all up himself. He wouldn't let anyone near while he was working on it.
Lewis.translation: Bună seara, @. Te-ai aventurat deja în labirintul bântuit? Este destul de înfricoșător.#$e#Bărbatul acela ciudat care locuiește în turn l-a amenajat singur. N-a lăsat pe nimeni să se apropie cât timp lucra la el.

Clint.source: One of my iridium-infused maces would make quick work of these things.
Clint.translation: Una dintre măciucile mele infuzate cu iridiu ar veni rapid de hac făpturilor acestora.
